page.notes: Greek entries in the middle and right columns are only partly legible at this scan resolution; they are marked [?] and their letters may be wrong. The "ut"/"u" spellings such as "uox", "uere" and "uerbi" are kept as printed. The "Mundi" and "Mors" entries in the right column may run on differently in the original. The small mark after "Mundo Paulus crucifixus" is a printer's mark and is not transcribed.
